_about: Synthetic recreations: every reel is generated (Gemini TTS voice, stock footage, burned-in overlays) from a script modelled on a type of case ASCI handles, not a real creator's video. Times are seconds. 'end' in an overlay means the video's last second.

compliance.decisionType: Paid promotion with no disclosure anywhere
compliance.script: Hey guys! I have been using GlowLeaf vitamin C serum for two weeks and my skin looks so fresh. GlowLeaf paid me to try it, and honestly I love it. It is just four hundred and ninety nine rupees on their website. Use my code ANJALI15 for fifteen percent off. Link in bio!

compliance.decisionType: Disclosure label shown too late and too briefly
compliance.script: This is my honest review of the Rockerz headphones from SoundNest. SoundNest partnered with me for this video. The bass is punchy, the battery lasted me almost three days, and the call quality is clear even on a busy road. For the price, these are a solid pick if you commute a lot. That's my review, see you in the next one.

declaration.caption: Ad: SoundNest Rockerz, my honest review #tech #headphones

controls.script: Today I'm making simple jeera rice. Heat a spoon of ghee, add cumin seeds, let them splutter, then add washed basmati rice and two cups of water. Cook on low for fifteen minutes and fluff it with a fork.

declaration.caption: Easy jeera rice for busy weeknights #recipe #indianfood

borrowed.label: Health Matters podcast, Dr. Meera Iyer
borrowed.source: Thanks for having me. People often ask me about intermittent fasting. Fasting for sixteen hours can help some adults lose weight. But if you have diabetes, you should never try it without your doctor. Low blood sugar can be dangerous. Most people see results in about a month. Drink enough water and sleep well.

borrowed.label: Science explainer, monsoon
borrowed.source: Every year the monsoon reaches Kerala in early June. It is driven by the difference in temperature between land and sea. The rains then move north over the following weeks. Farmers across India plan their sowing around it.
